'''Mufti''' is a men's clothing fashion brand, based in India and founded by Kamal Khushlani in 1998.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Sachdeva |first1=Sujata |title=With 15 percent growth Mufti plans an accessory line |url=https://fashionunited.in/news/fashion/with-15-per-cent-growth-mufti-plans-an-accessory-line/2014110310814 |publisher=Fashionunited.in |date=2014-03-11}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Mufti to launch women's jeans, plans IPO |url=https://fashionunited.in/v1/fashion/mufti-to-launch-womens-jeans-plans-ipo/201002168804 |publisher=Fashionunited.in |date=16 February 2010}}</ref> It manufactures shirts, jeans, t-shirts, [[sweatshirt]]s, [[sweater]]s, joggers, blazers and jackets.<ref name=businessline>{{cite news |last1=Law |first1=Abhishek |title=Denim and casual-wear brand Mufti plans to ramp up its product portfolio |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/denim-and-casual-wear-brand-mufti-plans-to-ramp-up-its-product-portfolio/article25446247.ece |publisher=Thehindubusinessline.com |date=2018-11-08}}</ref> It is owned and managed by Credo Brands Marketing Limited.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Chaudhary |first1=Deepti |last2=Agarwal |first2=Sapna |title=Carlyle to invest up to '250 crore in Mufti |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/9LTMChlaUr6qlX3wQBX5wL/Carlyle-to-invest-up-to-250-crore-in-Mufti.html |publisher=Livemint.com |date=2014-05-05}}</ref> It owns 1,400 multi brand outlets and 120 large format stores.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Sinha |first1=Partha |last2=Kurian |first2=Boby |title=Valued at Rs 750 crore - ChrysCapital set to buy Mufti in Rs 500 crore deal |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/garments-/-textiles/valued-at-rs-750-crore-chryscapital-set-to-buy-mufti-in-rs-500-crore-deal/articleshow/58852514.cms |publisher=Economictimes.indiatimes.com|date=2017-05-26}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Mufti's Goals: To be a global brand with Indian roots |url=https://fashionunited.in/v1/fashion/muftis-goals-to-be-a-global-brand-with-indian-roots/201205239464 |publisher=fashionunited.in |date=2012-05-23}}</ref>

==History==
The company was started with a ₹10,000 loan from Khushlani's maternal aunt. In 2014, [[Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd.]] and some of Khushlani's friends owned a 35 per cent stake and Khushlani holds a 65 per cent stake in the company.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Chaudhary |first1=Deepti |last2=Agarwal |first2=Sapna |title=Investors in Credo Brands in talks with firms as they seek exit |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/neS0gKR6eQ4DYV5ifM8zkM/Investors-in-Credo-Brands-in-talks-with-firms-as-they-seek-e.html |publisher=livemint.com |date=2013-10-12}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Balakrishnan |first1=Reghu |title=ChrysCapital close to buying Mufti denims brand for Rs460-500 crore |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/CCb9fshRfOgMdKTyIuLhPN/ChrysCapital-close-to-buying-Mufti-brand.html |publisher=Livemint.com |date=2017-05-26}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Roy |first1=Debjyoti |title=Mufti brand's promoter eyes stake sale, hires I-banker |url=https://www.vccircle.com/mufti-brand-s-promoter-eyes-stake-sale-hires-i-banker |publisher=Vccircle.com |date=2016-09-26}}</ref>

Mufti expanded into the footwear in December 2018.<ref>{{cite news |title=Mufti to expand footwear retail to 500 stores |url=https://www.exchange4media.com/announcements-news/mufti-to-expand-footwear-retail-to-500-stores-93387.html |publisher=Exchange4media.com |date=2018-12-10}}</ref> In 2018, the brand announced it will be expanding its product portfolio by focusing on athleisure clothing and accessories.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/denim-and-casual-wear-brand-mufti-plans-to-ramp-up-its-product-portfolio/article25446247.ece|title=Denim and casual-wear brand Mufti plans to ramp up its product portfolio|last=Law|first=Abhishek|date=2018-11-08|website=The Hindu Business Line|language=en|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-02-06}}</ref>{{needs update|date=June 2022}}  In July 2018, Mufti signed [[Kartik Aaryan]] as a [[brand ambassador]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Kartik Aaryan becomes brand ambassador of 'Mufti' |url=http://www.uniindia.com/kartik-aaryan-becomes-brand-ambassador-of-mufti/entertainment/news/1278911.html |publisher=uniindia.com |date=2018-04-07}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Kartik Aaryan unveiled MUFTI's Autumn Winter '18 Collection |url=https://www.adgully.com/kartik-aaryan-unveiled-mufti-s-autumn-winter-18-collection-80737.html |publisher=Adgully.com |date=2018-01-10}}</ref>

In February 2019, Mufti was recognized as a "Retailer of the Year" award at Global Awards for Retail Excellence organised by [[ET Now]] and Asia Retail Congress<ref name="indiantelevision">{{cite news |title=MUFTI bags 'Retailer of the Year' award at Global Awards for Retail Excellence |url=http://www.indiantelevision.com/mam/marketing/mam/mufti-bags-retailer-of-the-year-award-at-global-awards-for-retail-excellence-190215 |publisher=Indiantelevision.com |date=2019-02-15}}</ref> and won CMAI's Brand of the Year Award in 2015.<ref name="apparelresources">{{cite news |title=CMAI's Apex Awards 2015 for Indian apparel industry announced |url=https://apparelresources.com/events-news/cmais-apex-awards-2015-for-indian-apparel-industry-announced/ |publisher=Apparelresources.com |date=2015-04-11}}</ref>
